profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc operates the Uber platform. Its website describes the platform and apps as ways for users to earn more, eat, commute, get a ride, and simplify business travel. The site also states that Uber is introducing autonomous vehicles, describing a safety-driven approach that combines autonomous vehicles and drivers and involves partnerships with industry leaders.

The company's site positions autonomous vehicles as a key part of its future, but the available material does not name specific AI products beyond this autonomous vehicle initiative.

Uber Technologies, Inc is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, CA, trading under the ticker UBER, with SEC CIK 0001543151. The company has 281 law exposure entries in California. No litigation cases are listed.
